project.name: documentgen
project.description:
Event-driven document generation (DOCX/PDF/XLSX/PPTX/CSV/TXT/MD/JSON) - a new sibling module, same shape as "imagegen": a genuinely new capability with its own entity/service/controller/tool-callback surface, not bolted onto an existing module (see core/pom.xml's header comment for the "modular monolith" reasoning this repeats every time).
POST /api/documentgen/documents enqueues a job (quota/plan-gated, mirrors VideoGenerationQuotaService - FREE plan rejected outright, PREMIUM/ UNLIMITED get tunable daily/monthly caps); the job is generated asynchronously off an in-process Spring ApplicationEvent (DocumentGenerationRequestedEvent, consumed by a @TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT) + @Async listener) by one of the per-format DocumentGenerator @Component beans in generator.impl (added by later PRs - this module ships the registry/SPI only, no implementations yet). GET /api/documentgen/documents/{id} streams the finished bytes through this module's own authenticated controller, exactly like GeneratedImageController/VideoGenerationController - a tool result (see core/agents' eventual DocumentGenerationToolCallback) can only return a JSON reference, never raw binary, so the bytes always land in object storage first.
Depends on: tenancy (PlatformSettingsService - live-tunable quota caps, same as VideoGenerationQuotaService; transitively brings in security's TenantContext/TenantLimits/TenantPlan, declared explicitly below per this codebase's "explicit-declare-what-you-import" convention - see eventbus/pom.xml's own comment for the same rule). security (TenantContext/ TenantLimits/TenantPlan, explicit per that same convention). storage (FileStorageService - generated bytes are stored the same S3-compatible way GeneratedImageService/VideoGenerationJobService already do). eventbus (WorkflowEventPublisher/WorkflowEventTypes - a document.generation.completed event, flag-gated and swallowed on failure, never able to fail a job). No cycle: none of tenancy/security/storage/eventbus depends on documentgen.
